title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of major jackpot draws on Nov. 23
summary: There were no winners in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 23, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Monday.

blocks.text: There were no winners in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 23, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Monday.
The Grand Lotto 6/55 prize in the 9 p.m. draw stood at P45,000.000. The winning numbers were 34-48-04-49-22-08.
For Megalotto 6/45, the combination of 40-38-18-42-43-39 would have given the winners a P35,125,470.58 bonanza.
